title: The Human Trisome Project
brief_summary: The Human Trisome Project will significantly increase the speed of Down syndrome research and the understanding of associated medical conditions. Its biobank will provide de-identified samples to research.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Anyone 6 months to 89 years old who:

1. has Down syndrome (any type)
2. does not have Down syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Prisoners
2. Wards of the state
study_population: Individuals with Down syndrome, individuals related to someone with Down syndrome or of the general population who do not have a relationship to Down syndrome.
